design_verdict: No design-level blocker; valid as post hoc exploratory score-based sensitivity/stability/descriptive accounting subject to implementation checks.

findings.requirement: Keep occurrences with paired A/B and labels; no patient_id set/deduplication.
Use original patient_id string; stable sampled occurrence index as tertiary tie-break.
Rerank resampled scores and select50 occurrences; calibration-only equal50 external remains -6.25pp.
Use joint-valid draws, ties separate; descriptive resampling frequency, not posterior superiority probability.
Detection F_s/F and TP_s/F_s; review N_s/N and R_s/N_s. Detection mix is conditional on low-quality status.
No zero-imputation; valid count per statistic and per stratum-denominator condition.
Dataset-reported benign/malignant classification, not universal histopathology.
No independent patients, clinical effectiveness, causal effects, equivalence or human prompt validation.

six_case_cpu_feasibility: Principally feasible with exact checkpoint and CPU dependencies in a separately documented float32 environment; actual memory/runtime must be measured.
synthetic_prompt_caveat: Correlated algorithmic shifts from the reference-derived box are not independent human prompts or readers.
interpretation_cautions: Fixed-cutoff empirical bootstrap cannot generate an A-only failure outcome absent from the original 16 failure cases; its [0,+40]pp percentile interval must not override the original Newcombe [-4.28,+40.04] interval or imply superiority.
Calibration-only percentile intervals condition on the original test cohorts and are not population test-performance uncertainty.
final_status: Complete; no remaining numerical or implementation blocker. Boundary/conditional bootstrap interpretation cautions retained.
review_scope: Read-only protocol/scripts/results review; only this reviewer report and JSON were written. No experiment settings or source files changed.
